---
title: "CNSplot"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false

library(pixture)

cnsplot <- read.csv("files/CNSplot.csv")
cnsplot <- cnsplot[cnsplot$link != "",]
title <- cnsplot$title
paths <- paste("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZhengTiger/PlotOnePiece/refs/heads/main/images/CNSplot/", cnsplot$image, sep="")
link <- cnsplot$link
captions <- paste0(
  "<div style='line-height:0.1;'>",
  paste0("<div style='font-size:1rem;margin-bottom:0.0rem;line-height:1;color:black;'><b>", title, "</b></div>"),
  "</div>"
)
```

```{css}
#| echo: false

.pixgallery-caption-below {
    background: #c8e5ba;
    margin-top: 2px;
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

pixgallery(
  path = paths,
  caption = captions,
  caption_valign = "below",
  caption_halign = "center",
  link = link,
  h = "150px",
  w = "200px", 
  gap = "20px",
  layout = "fixed"
)
```
